card.name: Ending of dosage-form words
card.fires_on: The last piece of a dosage-form term such as chewable, caplet or delayed-release, just before the noun tablets, capsules or suspension.

modes.label: Chewable
modes.description: The ending of chewable right after a product name or Chew, before Tablets.
modes.example: Iron Multivitamin Chew<<able>> Tablets is best absorbed when taken at bedtime

modes.label: Caplet
modes.description: The ending of caplet or caplets after cap, often after a number of mg.
modes.example: 4.1) RA: 1200 mg (four 300 mg cap<<lets>>) given orally once a day (

modes.label: Delayed-release
modes.description: The word Release after Delayed- in a formulation name, before Tablets, Capsules or Suspension.
modes.example: Iron Content of Mesalamine Delayed-<<Release>> Capsules: Consider the iron content of

card.writes: It favors words for tablets, capsules and supplements, so it predicts a dosage-form noun next.
card.plain: It marks the end of a formulation word like chewable or delayed-release, when a word like tablets or capsules should follow.
